review: Read-only investigation of the v0.6.1 Windows parallel-worker CI failure

ci.observed_failure: first_release expected two pending patches in both builds; solo had query and presentation, team had only presentation.
ci.suite_result: 1 failed, 291 passed, 1 skipped, 7 warnings in 130.68 seconds.
ci.retry_status: Attempt 2 completed successfully on Windows at 2026-11-14T19:37:54Z; the overall tag workflow is successful.
ci.log_limitation: The assertion does not print team.outcomes or save its journal as a CI artifact, so the failing worker exception is unavailable.

source_findings.finding: TaskBoard.snapshot reads board.json without the board lock. Concurrent transaction writes hold the lock and replace that file at line 163.
WorkshopSession.read likewise reads journal.json without the write lock.
write_json writes a unique temporary file, then calls Path.replace at line 28; there is no retry for a Windows sharing violation.
The pending patch-count assertion hides worker outcome/error details.

free_checks.result: 1 passed in 2.82 seconds; Provider.complete is mocked.

free_checks.method: Used the existing fixture and both real initial-build paths. Temporarily monkeypatched Path.read_text to hold a board.json read open for 2ms and Path.replace to raise PermissionError when a concurrent reader held that path, modeling Windows no-delete-sharing behavior. This patch existed only in that Python process.

result.query_error: PermissionError: Simulated Windows sharing violation while a concurrent reader holds board.json

free_checks.caveat: This reproduces the exact visible symptom but does not establish the actual CI cause. It is a modeled sharing conflict on macOS, not a Windows execution or a captured failing CI journal.

assessment: A runtime read/write race is credible. The available CI output does not support calling the failure a timeout or infrastructure-only flakiness. A successful rerun would not prove that the race is absent.
release_qualification: Disclose that Windows parallel-worker reliability remains under investigation. Hosted notebooks and macOS/Linux are the qualified paths for this presentation release; no fresh live attendee rehearsal is implied.
possible_followup_scope: Protect TaskBoard.snapshot and WorkshopSession.read with their existing reentrant locks, reviewing lock order before changing behavior.
Include worker outcomes in the assertion failure and retain a sanitized failing journal on CI.
Add a deterministic overlapping-read/write regression and stress the parallel path on Windows. Do not rerun successful paid work or silently retry ambiguous model requests.
changes: No runtime, test, experiment, model call, or release source changes; this diagnosis file is the only written deliverable.
